data.segment_title: Economy: Global Financial Crisis / The Bailout
data.segment_description:
(Studio: Dan Harris)  This fierce financial panic noted; Stock market figures for last week cited.  

(Studio: Bianna Golodryga)  A global effort to prevent another financial nosedive featured; details given about Europe's emergency plan for the banks and about the US bailout plan that would partially nationalize private banks.  ["New York Times" Andrew SORKIN†- says fear is ruling the day in the market; states there are questions about the US money that will be used.]  Experts' view that there needs to be money for banks and to stop the slide in home prices noted and the revision of the bank bailout approach discussed.  

(Studio: Dan Harris)  Reports from around the world about the global crisis introduced.  

(Dubai: Lara Setrakian)  The economy of the Persian Gulf states noted.  

(Beijing: Stephanie Sy)  The plunge in the Asian stock markets noted.  

(Moscow: Clarissa Ward)  The reaction of the Russian commodities-based economy to the global crisis noted.  

(Nairobi, Kenya: Dana Hughes)  The cash-based economies in sub-Saharan Africa in a global crisis noted.  

(Baghdad: John Hendren)  The absence of an impact of the cash-based Iraqi economy noted; scenes shown from the Iraqi stock exchange.]

(Studio: Dan Harris)  Report introduced.   (St. Clairsville, Ohio: Ron Claiborne)  The backlash in the presidential election campaign to Senator John McCain's negative campaigning featured; scenes shown from eastern Ohio and from angry outbursts against Senator Barack Obama at McCain/Palin rallies.  [McCAIN&nbsp- tells a woman Obama is a decent man.]  Findings of a new ABC News/"Washington Post" poll on the public's opposition to attack campaigning cited.  [McCAIN&nbsp- reacts to remarks from Representative John Lewis.]  ["The Rothenberg Political Report" Stuart ROTHENBERG†- questions the chaos in McCain's message.]   (Studio: Dan Harris)  Report introduced.   (Oregon and Toledo, Ohio: Jake Tapper)  The Obama campaign's focus on the battleground states of Ohio and Pennsylvania featured; scenes shown from Pennsylvania of Obama going door-to-door and of Senator Hillary Clinton campaigning in Scranton.  [In Ohio on Thursday, OBAMA&nbsp- says we intend to win Ohio.]  [Senator Joe BIDEN&nbsp- campaigns.]

Economy: Global Financial Crisis / Soros Interview
data.segment_description: (Studio: Dan Harris)  The criticism of the administration from finance billionaire George Soros in his book "The New Paradigm for Financial Markets" noted.  [In interview today, SOROS&nbsp- says a coherent plan could stabilize the stock market; notes we are on the brink and something pulls you back as people see government intervention is necessary; suggests there are bargains in a time like this; indicates for the last 25 years we have been consuming more than we produce and we will have more debt.]
